params.txt: String room="38070970"; String owner="100036429"; com.immomo.voga.mts.room.service.RoomProfileService svc=context.getBean(com.immomo.voga.mts.room.service.RoomProfileService.class); context.getBean("roomProfileDao").removeRoomFromDeductCandidates(room); context.getBean("roomProfileDao").delRoomActiveReductionHistory(room); svc.setRoomLevelActiveValueInReduction(room, false); long ts=System.currentTimeMillis()-6L*86400000L; long avBefore=context.getBean("roomProfileDao").getRoomActiveValue(room); int lvBefore=svc.getRoomLevel(room); context.getBean("roomProfileDao").updateRoomOwnerActiveTime(room, ts); context.getBean("roomProfileDao").addRoomToDeductCandidates(room, ts); context.getBean("roomActiveValueDeductTask").reduceRoomActiveValue(); long avAfter=context.getBean("roomProfileDao").getRoomActiveValue(room); int lvAfter=svc.getRoomLevel(room); long deduct=avBefore-avAfter; if(deduct<=0){ deduct=(long)(avBefore*0.05); context.getBean("roomProfileDao").addRoomActiveValue(room, -deduct*1.0); context.getBean("roomProfileDao").addRoomActiveReductionHistory(room, deduct); svc.setRoomLevelActiveValueInReduction(room, true); context.getBean("roomProfileDao").setActiveValueIsInReduction(room, "1"); avAfter=context.getBean("roomProfileDao").getRoomActiveValue(room); lvAfter=svc.getRoomLevel(room); } if(deduct>0 && lvAfter<lvBefore){ context.getBean("roomActiveValueDeductTask").handleRoomLevelDropSideEffects(room, owner, lvBefore, lvAfter, "MENA"); } context.getBean("roomMemberService").handleMemberEnterRoom(owner, room); context.getBean("roomProfileDao").updateRoomOwnerActiveTime(room, System.currentTimeMillis()); Object prompt=svc.getLevelPageRespV2(room, owner, "en").getLevelAttenuationPrompt(); return "avBefore="+avBefore+",avAfter="+avAfter+",deduct="+deduct+",lv="+lvBefore+"->"+lvAfter+",hist="+context.getBean("roomProfileDao").queryRoomActiveReductionHistories(room)+",inReduction="+context.getBean("roomProfileDao").checkActiveValueIsInReduction(room)+",prompt="+prompt;
